title: Read-only Product Identity Impact Assessment
role: Agent-1 — Windows Development Agent / Technical Architect

baseline_verification.checkpoint_bundle_verify: The bundle records a complete history

database_isolation.limitation: ephemeral local cluster with no real customer data

d1_alias_uniqueness.interpretation: structural zero — the denominator is zero; NOT evidence of a conflict-free system
d1_alias_uniqueness.code_finding: the add-alias write path already rejects cross-product aliases with 409 alias_collision (product-identity.service.ts:447-452); DB constraint remains (product_id, alias_norm)
d1_alias_uniqueness.scan_dependency: scanResolve order barcode -> product.code -> alias kind=code; ambiguity raises 409 ambiguous_scan (product-master.service.ts:509-557)
d1_alias_uniqueness.import_dependency: product CSV import touches neither aliases nor attributes

normalization_findings.detail: normalizeText preserves a single internal space; normalizeBarcode strips all spaces; digits and case ARE folded
normalization_findings.consequence: cross-product collision checks can miss space-separated and Persian-digit variants

d4_required_attributes.interpretation: structural zero — no required attribute is defined, so no product can be incomplete
d4_required_attributes.code_finding: requiredness is enforced only when attribute values are written (400 required_attribute_missing); product creation performs no attribute validation; CSV import ignores attributes

scope_comparison.B: category-scoped, needs a link table plus three companion rules
scope_comparison.C: family-scoped, NOT evaluable — product_family is empty and unrelated to attributes
scope_comparison.D: optional, lowest cost, weakest data quality

schema_cannot_answer: real number of alias duplicates in the organization
role of product family in requiredness
impact of options B/C on historical data

c8_self_correction.cause: counting error in C8 (row attribution was correct; only the count was wrong)
c8_self_correction.note: the 126 figure was never deleted, only corrected here

c8_residue_preservation.why_not_cleaned: product_catalog_history is append-only (dms_app granted SELECT only)
c8_residue_preservation.attribution_vs_cleanup_distinction: attribution confidence is high; cleanup completion is NOT achieved and must not be

owner_summary_fa: دادهٔ کافی برای تصمیم در این محیط نیست؛ صفرهای گزارش «صفرِ ساختاری»‌اند. دو یافتهٔ کد مستقل از داده معتبرند: (۱) مسیرِ ثبت از امروز هم‌نامی بین کالاها را رد می‌کند، پس گزینهٔ B بیشتر تضمینِ داده است تا قابلیت؛ (۲) نرمال‌سازی ی/ک و فاصله ناقص است و باید پیش از سخت‌ترکردنِ قاعده رفع شود. برای D4، الزام فعلی عملاً «الزامِ ویرایش» است نه الزامِ ساخت.
